R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

rig.rest_pose: standing pose as modelled (not a T pose)
rig.animation: none: skeleton and skin weights only; no clips, no Physics Asset, no control rig
rig.skeleton: bespoke (CONVENTIONS.md section 11: any skeleton with a single root bone named root)

pivot: feet: armature origin on the ground between the feet, front on -Y
dresses: stone giant: a knuckle-walking, ape-built giant of bedded tan sandstone, 2.1 m at the shoulder and 1.9 m across, with massive forearms, a small head sunk between the shoulders and deep-set eye pits
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound to any placement
known_weaknesses: NOT photoreal at 1 m: a blob figure with a rock texture. The body is a fused joint graph with strata, jointing and chips from displacement; it does not break into separate blocks at the joints, so it reads as a stone-skinned ape rather than as stacked rock. Eyes and mouth are displaced pits only. The game mesh is a decimation (no joint loops) and stone should not stretch: skinned deformation will smear the bedding at the shoulders and hips; rigid chunks per bone would be the right build. Inverse-distance or bone-heat automatic weights, one test pose. No animation clips, no Physics Asset.
